categories.main_business_segments: Sunjin Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four main business segments: compound feed manufacturing and sales, pork production (pig farming), meat processing and sales, and meat product manufacturing. The company also engages in related businesses such as livestock equipment sales and real estate leasing. The feed segment accounts for the largest revenue share, followed by meat, pig farming, and meat processing segments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced feed formulation and quality control technologies in its compound feed production, incorporating imported raw materials like corn, wheat, and soybean meal. In pig farming, it applies optimized breeding and disease management programs. Meat processing employs hygienic and quality control systems including HACCP and proprietary quality systems (SPQS). The company also invests in research centers focused on feed technology, pig farming, cattle farming, and meat quality innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include livestock farmers who purchase compound feed directly, large retail chains and wholesale distributors for meat products, and contract farming partners in pig production. The company serves primarily the domestic Korean market, with some export activities historically, but current sales are predominantly domestic. Major end markets are livestock farming and food retail sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Sunjin is headquartered in South Korea with domestic operations and 11 domestic subsidiaries. It also has a significant international presence with 14 subsidiaries across five countries including Myanmar, China, Vietnam, India, and the Philippines. Production facilities for feed and meat products are located both domestically and in these overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates vertically integrated across the livestock supply chain, including upstream feed production, midstream pig farming, and downstream meat processing and sales. It controls raw material procurement, livestock breeding, meat processing, and distribution, positioning itself as a midstream to downstream player with upstream feed manufacturing capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Sunjin focuses on strengthening technological capabilities in feed formulation, livestock breeding, and meat quality through dedicated research centers. R&D initiatives emphasize cost competitiveness, quality enhancement, and sustainability including environmental management and animal welfare. The company also pursues digital transformation and ESG activities to improve operational efficiency and brand value.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales including compound feed, live pigs (for pork production), fresh meat products, and processed meat products. Sales channels include direct sales to farmers, retail distribution to supermarkets and wholesalers, and online sales platforms. The company also earns income from related businesses such as livestock equipment sales and real estate leasing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the compound feed market, Sunjin holds an estimated 4-5% domestic market share, competing against major players like Nonghyup (approx. 30% market share) and other feed companies. In meat and pork production, it holds about 4-5% market share domestically. The company is recognized for its vertical integration and quality branding, positioning it as a leading comprehensive livestock food company in Korea with competitive advantages in technology and supply chain integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the latest fiscal year, Sunjin reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.9 trillion KRW with operating profit of about 97.5 billion KRW, reflecting a 1.88% revenue increase and 38.13% operating profit growth year-over-year. Total assets stand at about 1.26 trillion KRW with a debt ratio of approximately 184%. The company has maintained stable growth with ongoing investments in overseas subsidiaries and product diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunjin emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced feed and livestock products supported by vertical integration from feed to meat processing. Its value proposition includes consistent product quality, cost competitiveness, and strong brand recognition such as the 'Sunjin Pork' brand. The company also differentiates through sustainability initiatives, animal welfare leadership, and comprehensive customer service including technical support and consulting for farmers.
